g.text: Note: authors are grouped by the year of their first Showcase+ publication inside 2015–2025. Paper and citation contributions use fractional co-author credit.
Top-decile paper credit uses the citation cut-off measured for each (year, FOR L4 field) against the whole database — not a threshold pooled across years.
